_readme: Shared domain constants for the Python build and, later, the browser build. Keep this the single source of truth; the two implementations cannot disagree about whether account 10506 is internal time if the number lives in one place.
_internal_project_readme: Some projects sit on project job numbers but are funded from CICERO's own strategic pot rather than by a customer, and the finance system marks them with their own activity code. They are project work and they are budgeted, but no invoice comes out of them: every such row carries a zero billing price. Funding is a property of the project rather than of the row, so a job counts as internally funded if any of its rows carry the code. internal_project_label is what the dashboard calls the programme; if it is renamed, change it here and both builds follow.
